messages:
maria_sales: Hey team — SirenProof just signed the NDA and asked to run a short perf validation next Wed. They want a smoke + sustained + microburst exercise. Need: (1) load plan we can share with Ops, (2) hosted vs Dedicated cost estimate for the POC, (3) wording for the security checklist re: KMS/audit logs. Can we coordinate? :wave:

devon_se: I can own the runbook. Quick notes from the model profile they shared: avg input ~450 tokens, gen ~150 tokens. Initial guess: ~20–25ms p50 on an A100-class node at 80 qps, but tail will vary with caching and network. Proposed plan: smoke 15m @20 qps, sustained 30m @80 qps, then 8 microbursts 30s @220 qps spaced 90–120s apart. Will produce JMeter and a small Python harness.

tessops: Ops notes: Dedicated pool gives best tail stability during microbursts — hosted can handle it but you need burst autoscaling (we recommend 2x nodes for short bursts). Need their IP allowlist and an SLA decision (they asked about 99.9% vs 99.95%). Also KMS + audit logs are enterprise add-ons; ops needs contact in their infra team for key rotation/ownership.

raj_eng: @devon_se can you paste the exact test curl/payload we should give them? also do we want to exercise cold starts (kv cache disabled) vs warm runs?

devon_se: Snippet to hit the perf endpoint (give them a test key):

```
POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "model": "redwood-xl-1.0",
  "input": "Summarize the following: <SAMPLE_PROMPT_PLACEHOLDER>",
  "max_tokens": 180,
  "stream": false
}
```

To simulate cold path include header `X-RW-KV-Cache: false`. For warm path include `X-RW-Warm: true`. The harness will do both.

maria_sales: For pricing, legal asked for a ballpark: assume 100k gen tokens for the run + 2 days of followups. Can someone give hosted per-token rug estimate and Dedicated day-rate? They want it in the next 24h. Also reminder: their security questionnaire flagged KMS + audit logs and SOC2.

tessops: Hosted back-of-envelope: ~$0.0004 per gen token -> 100k tokens ≈ $40 token cost. Ops/infra overhead and support for the run -> estimate ~$120 total for hosted POC run. Dedicated: small reserved 1-GPU day-rate ~ $450/day (covers the node + monitoring/ops). Enterprise add-ons (KMS + audit retention) -> one-time ~ $500 setup fee and a ~$200/month retention surcharge. I'll put numbers in a short doc.

devon_se: I'll run a pre-check tomorrow 09:00 PST against staging endpoints. @raj_eng can you watch metrics (prometheus + rtail) and validate tail-latency sampling? I'll share the Grafana link and the harness repo.

ci-bot: deploy: test-runner v3.7 deployed to perf cluster by @ci-bot

raj_eng: I'll be on-call during the run. Quick ask: enable trace sampling 1% and token-level logging for the run window. Also flip on percentile windows in rtail (p50/p95/p99).

maria_sales: Great — I'll send SirenProof the proposed schedule + ask for IP ranges and their KMS contact. Thanks all :thumbsup:
